findings.finding: queueEvidenceEventSpan catches recordEvidenceEvent exceptions; ToolPipeline separately catches record callback errors and returns the finalized outcome. agentToolset's ordinary ledger batch transaction finishes before queue dispatch, but a nested caller transaction owns the outer commit and the ledger owns only a savepoint. Do not claim universal durable commit before telemetry queue. The direct throwing READ_ONLY echo callback in recording7 independently reaches the pipeline barrier; telemetry2 alone does not isolate that outer catch or the inner catch.

Recording7 includes5 actual workspace/SQLite cases,1direct callback failure case and1pure projection case. It asserts OBSERVED allowed/denied/correlated rows, exact audit+metric types/counts and no duplicated argument marker, plus echo's original outcome despite actual callback throw.
